description: Narrow and elongated. Living bright bedrooms dim. Deep — views through multiple spaces. Clear functional corridor connecting zones. Kitchen: L-shaped or U-shaped, no island or peninsula — counter set back from windows, moderate natural light. Cook faces the wall — back to the living and dining area. Two cooks can work simultaneously on separate counter runs. Fully open plan — no wall separates kitchen from dining and living. Living arrangement: split seating-kitchen-dining, kitchen on side wall. Seating: one sofa in the living area facing the TV wall on the lower exterior side. Dining table (6 seats). TV on wall right of entry. Cook can see TV from cooking position. Diners do not face the TV. Entry: corridor entry, first thing visible on arrival is bedroom doors, L-shaped corridor, medium length. No door between entry and living — relevant where local regulations require separation. Master suite (en-suite bathroom) — accessed via own door off corridor, no walk-in wardrobe. Master suite (en-suite bathroom) closest to entry — lighter acoustic separation from the arrival zone. Secondary bedroom 1 — accessed via own door off corridor. The single bedroom can function as a dedicated home office, hobby room, guest room, or children's bedroom. 0 of 1 have a desk visible in plan. Single bedroom use options: children's bedroom / dedicated home office / hobby or creative studio / guest room. Storage: one wardrobe. Sanitary rooms: bathroom (shower and toilet); bathroom (shower, bathtub, and toilet). Bathroom accessed directly from the living area — no private corridor. Two bathrooms — two people can shower simultaneously, parallel morning and evening routines possible. Suits: couples needing a dedicated home office or hobby room; small families with one child; two adults sharing independently — each with private bathroom access. Not suitable for: wheelchair users needing wide turning corridors due to the narrow elongated layout and L-shaped circulation; large families needing more than two bedrooms; those wanting a home office with natural light as no dedicated extra room exists.
